args.summary: Defensive quality + inflation-hedge book for a low-confidence Stagflation (Q3) regime — inflation 0.818 dominant, growth ~0, PBoC liquidity contracting, regime confidence 0.308, pending Q2. Core ballast: 国电电力 (600795.SS) regulated-utility anchor and 陕西煤业 (601225.SS) low-cost high-dividend coal as the inflation leg. Earnings-backed healthcare quality (RS#3, mom_60d +22%): alpha-leader 振德医疗 (603301.SS), profitable devices 南微医学 (688029.SS), companion-dx 艾德生物 (300685.SZ), profitable pharma 京新药业 (002020.SZ), and breadth 润达医疗 (603108.SS). One measured growth slice via alpha-leader semiconductor test-handler 金海通 (603061.SS). Today I finish de-risking the worst macro fit — full exit of unprofitable clinical biotech 迈威生物 (688062.SS) — standard-trim the uncorroborated industrial cyclical 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ), and redeploy into a confirmed uptrend quality pharma leader 恒瑞医药 (600276.SS). No banks exposure is deliberate given the desk's credit/flow warning that bank leadership is stretched. Cash stays elevated as dry powder pending regime clarity.

holdings.rationale: 振德医疗 (603301.SS), a wound-care/medical-supplies maker, is the book's largest healthcare position and the #1 name in the corroborated China intake (alpha leader, resid α 2.92, entry now reads intact rather than the earlier pullback). It sits in RS#3 Healthcare (mom_60d +22%, above 200d, 77th pctile). Down -4.5%, the chart reads as a buyable pullback within a leading sector, not a breakdown, and no explicit falsifier has fired — under churn-hysteresis I HOLD.
holdings.why_now: Remains the top-ranked corroborated alpha leader with entry intact, inside the #3 RS sector that is holding above its 200d trend; no fresh trigger to act.
holdings.falsifier: Drops out of the alpha-leader board, loses the recent swing low, or Healthcare RS rolls below its 200d trend within 5 days.
evidence: china_intake score 0.973, alpha leader resid α 2.92 entry intact
china_regime RS#3 Healthcare mom_60d +21.9%, above 200d, 77.8 pctile
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit if it leaves the alpha-leader board or Healthcare RS breaks its 200d trend.

holdings.rationale: 京新药业 (002020.SZ) is a profitable generics/API pharma in RS#3 Healthcare, down -11% and already trimmed twice in late September. Per my measured churn-hysteresis lesson I explicitly do NOT trim it a third time absent a freshly fired falsifier, hard price/technical break, or material thesis change — none has occurred. Profitable, earnings-backed pharma is the right defensive exposure for a Stagflation / contracting-liquidity regime.
holdings.why_now: No new falsifier since the last two trims; profitable pharma remains regime-appropriate defensive quality, so a third reversal would be churn.
holdings.falsifier: A hard price/technical break below recent lows, an earnings/guidance cut, or Healthcare RS leadership breaking down.
evidence: portfolio meta-memory: trimmed 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24, churn-hysteresis lesson
holdings.exit_plan: Exit on a fundamental deterioration (margin/guidance) or a confirmed technical breakdown.

holdings.rationale: 陕西煤业 (601225.SS) is my inflation hedge — a low-cost, high-dividend coal producer in RS#1 Coal (mom_60d +22.5%, 98.8 pctile, above 200d). With the inflation leg dominant (0.818) and liquidity contracting, a dividend-paying commodity producer is both an inflation beneficiary and a defensive dividend attribute, and it is a book winner (+9.8%). I HOLD rather than ADD because the in-house brief flags coal/bank winners as stretched — I keep the exposure without chasing it.
holdings.why_now: Inflation score 0.818 keeps the hedge relevant and Coal is RS#1, but the brief warns the leaders are stretched, so I hold rather than add.
holdings.falsifier: Coal loses RS#1 / breaks its 200d trend, or the inflation score falls materially toward the growth quadrant.
evidence: china_regime inflation_score 0.818, Coal RS#1 mom_60d +22.5% 98.8 pctile
holdings.exit_plan: Trim into strength if coal RS fades or the regime inflation leg rolls over.

holdings.rationale: 国电电力 (600795.SS) is the book's defensive anchor — a large regulated power utility with resilient, dividend-backed earnings, the ballast a Stagflation / contracting-liquidity regime rewards, partly hedged on coal-cost by my 陕西煤业 holding. It is a winner (+5.2%). Having added to it last session it is already my largest-by-intent defensive weight (~18%), so today I HOLD rather than add further to avoid over-concentrating a single name.
holdings.why_now: Regulated cash flows are precisely the defensive ballast the regime rewards, but the position is already large so I hold rather than add.
holdings.falsifier: A utility-sector breakdown, a dividend cut, or a sharp back-up in CGB yields that de-rates rate-sensitive utilities.
evidence: china_regime: Stagflation + contracting liquidity favors regulated defensives
holdings.exit_plan: Trim if the weight runs further or if long-bond yields spike against the utility.

holdings.rationale: 金海通 (603061.SS) is a semiconductor back-end test-handler maker the desk flags as a corroborated alpha leader (intake score 0.89, resid α 2.67, pullback entry). It is my one measured slice of semiconductor-equipment/secular-growth exposure to balance the defensive core, kept deliberately small (~4%) and on a pullback entry rather than chased. Down -8.3% with no falsifier fired; under churn-hysteresis I HOLD it small.
holdings.why_now: Still a corroborated alpha leader on a pullback entry; small size means it does not materially raise book risk on a growth-pressured, firm-dollar tape.
holdings.falsifier: Loses alpha-leader status, breaks its recent swing low, or a firm-dollar growth-share drawdown accelerates.
evidence: china_intake score 0.89 alpha leader resid α 2.67 entry pullback
holdings.exit_plan: Cut if it leaves the alpha board or breaks down; it is the first growth name to go if the dollar pressure worsens.

holdings.rationale: 南微医学 (688029.SS) is a profitable minimally-invasive medical-device maker in RS#3 Healthcare and a book winner (+1.6%). It is exactly the earnings-backed quality-defensive exposure the Stagflation regime rewards and it is confirming. Per confirmation-over-prediction I keep it at full weight and HOLD.
holdings.why_now: A profitable, confirming device maker in the leading defensive sector — no reason to disturb a working quality position.
holdings.falsifier: Healthcare RS rolls over, or an earnings/guidance miss, or a confirmed technical breakdown.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim on a Healthcare RS breakdown or a fundamental miss.

holdings.rationale: 艾德生物 (300685.SZ) is a companion-diagnostics / precision-oncology testing leader in RS#3 Healthcare and a book winner (+1.3%). It gives structural-growth, earnings-backed healthcare exposure distinct from devices and pharma, and it is working. A confirming position I HOLD rather than average down a loser.
holdings.why_now: Working confirming position in the leading sector; keep weight, do not chase into a firm-dollar open given its growth tilt.
holdings.falsifier: Breaks recent support, Healthcare RS rolls over, or a reimbursement/price-control headline hits diagnostics.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim on a technical breakdown or sector RS reversal.

holdings.rationale: 润达医疗 (603108.SS) is an IVD / medical-laboratory-services name in RS#3 Healthcare, nearly flat (-2.0%) at a small ~0.8% weight. It adds healthcare breadth distinct from devices/diagnostics/pharma and has not broken down. Small and in the leading sector, so I HOLD it as a low-conviction breadth position rather than churn out of a near-flat name with no falsifier fired.
holdings.why_now: Near-flat, tiny, no falsifier fired — churning a stub of this size would be exactly the behavior the hysteresis lesson warns against.
holdings.falsifier: A clear break below support, or Healthcare RS leadership breaking down.
holdings.exit_plan: Exit to consolidate if it breaks down or if I need the slot for higher-conviction breadth.

holdings.rationale: 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ) is an industrial refrigeration / cold-chain / compressor maker — a cyclical industrial, not a defensive, down -18% at ~2.7% weight. It carries no desk corroboration (absent from both the alpha intake and the standouts buy board) and is a poor fit for a weak-growth (growth 0.071) Stagflation regime with contracting liquidity. I TRIM it (standard) to de-risk the uncorroborated cyclical while keeping a residual position rather than a full reversal.
holdings.why_now: Weak-growth regime plus zero desk corroboration makes this the clearest cyclical misfit to reduce; a measured trim de-risks without a churn-y full reversal.
holdings.falsifier: Reclaims its downtrend / posts relative strength vs CSI 300, or industrials cycle inflects up with the pending Q2 turn — then I would stop trimming.
evidence: absent from china_intake and china_standouts (no corroboration)
holdings.exit_plan: Continue reducing toward exit if it keeps underperforming CSI 300 or breaks to new lows.

holdings.rationale: 恒瑞医药 (600276.SS) is China's bellwether innovative-pharma leader, which the standouts buy board flags as an UPTREND at a full-entry bucket (conviction 55, constructive) inside RS#3 Healthcare (mom_60d +22%, above 200d). This is a new, modest ADD that redeploys proceeds from the biotech exit and cyclical trim into confirmed, earnings-backed quality — confirmation over prediction (an established uptrend, not a speculative bottoming bet). It deepens my healthcare tilt deliberately, in the highest-quality expression of the #3 RS sector.
holdings.why_now: Desk flags it UPTREND / hold-add-on-dips with a full entry bucket, so the entry is clean and the trend is already confirmed — the right way to deploy cash in a low-confidence regime.
holdings.falsifier: Breaks its uptrend, drops off the buy board, or Healthcare RS rolls below its 200d trend within 5 days.
evidence: china_standouts: 600276.SS UPTREND, entry_bucket full, conviction 55 constructive
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit if the uptrend breaks, it leaves the buy board, or Healthcare RS fades.

exit_decisions.reason: 迈威生物 (688062.SS) is an unprofitable clinical-stage biotech — my deepest drawdown (-24%) and the single worst macro fit for this book. Unprofitable growth into contracting PBoC liquidity and a firm dollar is exactly the 'growth share under pressure' the in-house brief warns about, and the name carries no corroboration in the current intake. This is the final step of a multi-session de-risk (trimmed 2026-09-18, 2026-09-21, and 2026-10-08), not a fresh 3-day reversal, so it is fully consistent with my churn-hysteresis lesson.
evidence: get_my_book: -24.1% unrealized, deepest drawdown, unprofitable clinical biotech
china_brief: firm dollar + contracting liquidity pressure growth shares
exit_decisions.why_now: Liquidity is still contracting and the dollar firm, so the regime continues to punish unprofitable growth; completing the de-risk now removes the book's highest-risk, worst-fit exposure and funds the quality rotation.
exit_decisions.falsifier: I would reconsider only if PBoC liquidity turns expansionary AND the stock reclaims trend, or the company reaches profitability / a major positive clinical-commercial catalyst lands.

falsifiers: China system liquidity turns expansionary (PBoC injection / credit impulse up) — easing finally reaching markets would broaden a risk-on rally and leave this defensive, healthcare-heavy book lagging; I would rotate toward cyclicals/growth.
Regime confirms the pending flip from Q3 Stagflation to Q2 Reflation — I would shift from defense toward cyclical offense.

Healthcare RS#3 rolls below its 200d trend or loses momentum leadership — a sector shock (VBP/price-control headline) would hit several holdings at once and force me to cut the healthcare concentration.
Coal loses RS#1 / breaks its 200d trend or the inflation score falls materially toward the growth quadrant — removes the rationale for the 陕西煤业 inflation hedge.
A sharp firm-dollar / USDCNH move that accelerates a growth-share drawdown — I would cut 金海通 and 恒瑞/devices growth sensitivity faster.

technical_lab (DEGRADED for A-shares — context-only, no per-ticker chart/entry data available)
args.expected_failure_mode: The pending Q2 Reflation turn confirms and PBoC liquidity expands, driving a broad risk-on rally led by banks/cyclicals/growth that this defensive, healthcare-concentrated book underperforms versus the CSI 300; or healthcare (RS#3, now ~a third of the book across five names) de-rates together on a sector-specific shock — e.g., a volume-based-procurement or price-control headline — hitting multiple holdings simultaneously. Secondary risk: elevated cash drags relative performance if the tape simply grinds higher.
args.cash_rationale: Cash stays elevated (~37-40% after a roughly cash-neutral rotation: 迈威生物 exit + 冰轮环境 trim funding the 恒瑞医药 add) as deliberate dry powder, not an inability to find ideas. Regime confidence is low (0.308), the posture flip is fragile (0.05), PBoC liquidity is contracting, and the brief flags the current winners (banks/coal) as stretched — a low-conviction tape where forcing gross into speculative bottoming reversals would be poorly rewarded. I searched the full intake (top-30 alpha leaders) and standouts board; most non-held ideas are semis/materials growth names that fit the defensive, contracting-liquidity stance poorly, so I deployed only into one confirmed uptrend quality leader rather than filling gross. I hold the powder for a confirmed Q2 turn or a liquidity expansion. Final cash is the allocator's to set.
args.liquidity_notes: All retained names, the exit, and the new add are liquid mainland A-shares confirmed priceable via get_quote (native CNY). 金海通 (603061.SS) is the highest nominal price (~293 CNY) but liquid; the 冰轮环境 trim and 迈威生物 exit are modest sizes with no liquidity concern.
args.sold_note: Full exit of 迈威生物 (688062.SS): completing a multi-session de-risk of the book's deepest drawdown (-24%) and worst macro fit (unprofitable clinical biotech into contracting liquidity + firm dollar). Standard trim of 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ): reducing an uncorroborated industrial cyclical (-18%) that fits the weak-growth regime poorly. Proceeds rotate into confirmed quality pharma 恒瑞医药 (600276.SS).

decision_memo.market_frame: Stagflation Q3 — inflation_score 0.818 dominant, growth_score 0.071, PBoC liquidity contracting, regime confidence 0.308 (low), cycle mid, pending flip to Q2 (direction uncertain). Sector RS: Coal #1, Banks #2, Healthcare #3, Real Estate #4, Baijiu #5. Fear/euphoria Neutral (50), RORO neutral (-0.09), divergent/no-consensus. Brief: easing stuck in the pipes, firm dollar pressures growth/HK, bank+coal leadership looks stretched. Advisory shadow posture ROTATE_DEFENSIVE (offense 0.43).
decision_memo.candidate_funnel: Reviewed china_intake top-30 (dominated by semiconductor/materials alpha leaders — 金海通 held; 长川科技, 华峰测控, 拓荆科技, 中科飞测 etc.) and the china_standouts A-share buy board. Defensive-relevant candidates: 恒瑞医药 (UPTREND, full entry), 千禾味业 (consumer-defensive, BOTTOMING), 天富能源 (utility, BOTTOMING), plus stretched coal/bank leaders.
decision_memo.selected: ADD 恒瑞医药 (600276.SS) — confirmed UPTREND quality-pharma bellwether at a full-entry bucket in RS#3 Healthcare; redeploys exit/trim proceeds into earnings-backed quality (confirmation over prediction).

rejected.banks (512800 leaders): RS#2 but brief explicitly flags bank leadership as stretched with credit/flow desks weakening — credit warning, declined
rejected.semis/materials alpha leaders: strong resid-α but growth shares under firm-dollar + contracting-liquidity pressure; poor fit for the defensive stance
rejected.千禾味业 / 天富能源 / 康泰生物 / 海看股份: BOTTOMING reversal setups — too speculative to initiate in a low-confidence (0.308), fragile-flip regime

decision_memo.alternatives: Considered diversifying the defensive sleeve with 千禾味业 (consumer-defensive condiments, pricing power) or adding utility via 天富能源 instead of concentrating healthcare; chose 恒瑞 for confirmation-over-prediction (established uptrend vs a bottoming guess) and highest-quality expression of the leading sector. Also considered raising cash outright (no add) — rejected as too passive given a cash-neutral quality rotation was available.
decision_memo.changes: EXIT 迈威生物 (688062.SS, full); TRIM 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ, standard); ADD 恒瑞医药 (600276.SS, new); HOLD the other eight (振德/京新/陕西煤业/国电电力/金海通/南微/艾德/润达).
decision_memo.risk_deliberation: Healthcare concentration rises to roughly a third of the book across five names — accepted as a deliberate RS#3 bet taken in the highest-quality expressions (device/dx/innovative-pharma leaders), with the shared falsifier being a Healthcare RS breakdown or a VBP/price-control shock. No banks exposure is a deliberate choice given the credit warning. Inflation hedge (coal) + utility ballast retained. Cash kept elevated to respect low regime confidence and the fragile posture flip.
decision_memo.timing: Low regime confidence and a fragile (0.05) posture flip argue for measured moves only: finish the de-risk of the worst fit, trim one uncorroborated cyclical, deploy modestly into confirmation, and hold dry powder for a confirmed Q2 turn or a liquidity expansion.
decision_memo.context_gaps: technical_lab is DEGRADED for A-shares (status degraded, per-ticker chart/entry/golden-oracle fields missing) — no independent technical confirmation of entries/breakdowns, so I relied on intake/regime/brief and held positions absent a fired falsifier. Regime/brief data are dated (state as-of 2026-09-30 / 2026-10-08); no fresh intraday tape. Churn-hysteresis is cited as the governing discipline on all holds.
decision_memo.delegation_summary: Bounded single-session daily decision; analysis performed in-session against the China desks (regime, brief, standouts, intake, quotes, technical lab) with no subagent delegation required.
